answer: Durable resource footprint attestation. An identity must present hardware-signed telemetry showing sustained real compute and storage held across the network's kernel clock for weeks, so virtual instances spun up cheaply fail continuity checks. Attackers wander across providers seeking compliant hosts, but each accepted identity costs genuine reserved capacity and idle time. Proving uniqueness per orchard of co-located nodes then forces fresh physical hardware per sybil, making mass forgery capital- and time-expensive.
